description: This bar chart, titled “Strong Supervision” and featuring a legend indicating “Weak” supervision with a solid blue bar and “Strong” supervision with a blue bar containing diagonal stripes, illustrates the “Performance Gain (+%)” for two different large language models under two distinct supervision regimes. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (+%)”, is scaled linearly from 0 to 25, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The horizontal axis lists the model names: “Claude-3.5-Sonnet” and “Qwen2-72B”. For each model, two bars are presented side-by-side: the left bar represents “Weak” supervision and the right bar represents “Strong” supervision. For “Claude-3.5-Sonnet”, the “Weak” supervision bar has a value of approximately 7%, while the “Strong” supervision bar has a value of approximately 14%. For “Qwen2-72B”, the “Weak” supervision bar has a value of approximately 15%, and the “Strong” supervision bar has a value of approximately 25%. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the model names on the horizontal axis. The bars are visually distinct by their fill pattern (diagonal stripes for “Strong” supervision, solid for “Weak” supervision), and there are no annotations or emphasis applied to any specific bar.
